exposure: gestational age at elective caesarean section (38 weeks, 39 weeks, 40 weeks)
cohort: The study included 750 patients undergoing elective caesarean sections at 38, 39, or 40 weeks of gestation in a tertiary hospital.
finding: Neonatal outcomes showed similarity across elective caesarean sections performed at 38, 39, and 40 weeks of gestation.
mod_finding: Elective caesarean sections may be performed within a gestational range of 38 to 40 weeks, as neonatal outcomes at 38 weeks are comparable to those at 39 and 40 weeks.
followup_time: 1 and 5 minutes after birth (for Apgar scores), within the first hour of life (for hypothermia and hypoglycemia), other outcomes assessed during the neonatal period (e.g., feeding challenges, respiratory complications).
